lines: The host returns from a trip to Russia and responds to the media reaction to it. She says the episode thumbnail of her with Vladimir Putin is AI-generated (A-2617.1). She also says the trip was a family vacation that she and her husband paid for themselves, that their request for a Putin interview was denied, and that she joined a family panel at the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum (SPIEF), which a Trump administration delegation also attended. She plays a montage of critics (A-2618.1) and reads a Laura Loomer post (A-2618.2). In the post, Loomer alleges, citing a source, that the host and her husband met Alexander Dugin in Italy, and calls for FARA registration and FinCEN flags on their bank accounts. The host denies ever meeting Dugin. She then describes a medical emergency during the trip. According to the host, an American former-military member of their security detail had a stroke on the second day and needed emergency brain surgery in a Russian hospital, after years of failing to get a VA appointment.

The host then argues that there is a historical link between radical Zionism and Russia. She cites the People's Will assassination of Tsar Alexander II, an article by Deborah Hertz on Jewish women radicals (A-2620.1), the Romanov executions under Yakov Yurovsky, and a New York Times article on Julius Hammer's financing of the Soviet Bureau and diamond smuggling into New York (A-2620.2). She shows her video from the Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood (A-2621.1) and photos from the trip (A-2621.2), and urges viewers to visit Russia.

In the second segment the host covers Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit. She plays clips of Erika Kirk being heckled as protecting pedophiles (A-2622.1), Dana Loesch reciting Bible verses on widows (A-2622.2), and Alex Clark announcing her engagement on stage (A-2622.3). She says insiders told her the summit struggled to attract young women and that female chapter leaders declined to attend. She reads Alex Clark's posts, including one asking "how did Putin taste?" (A-2623.1) and one claiming credit for prompting Trump's rant against the host (A-2623.2). She also says Clark tried to get the sponsor Paleo Valley to drop the show, and she plays clips of Clark's fiancé, Vance Voetberg (A-2623.5).

The final segment covers the video in which Charlie Kirk appears to appoint Erika Kirk to run Turning Point USA (A-2625.2). The host recaps how the video came to light and plays a supercut of Charlie Kirk's views on women and careers (A-2624.1). She says TPUSA showed the video only to Daily Mail reporters, that donors present remember Charlie saying the board would figure it out, and that his Aspen presentation mentioned Erika only once (A-2625.1). The host says she believes the clip is doctored. She reads her emailed questions to TPUSA (A-2626.1) and the reply from the TPUSA X account saying the video was real and Charlie "wasn't kidding" (A-2626.2). In the comments she says the White House asked her to narrow her FOIA request on Erika Kirk and the correspondents' dinner shooting (A-2627.1).

lines: - **Duration mismatch**: the skeleton's Video Timestamp Range said 00:56:29, but the transcript front matter gives 1:22:06. The range is set to 01:22:06 per the spec. The skeleton's M-56 occurrence timestamp (00:07:43) and its truncated quote are kept verbatim, although the "Clown World" line sits in the [06:42] paragraph.

- **DIA scan**: no real DIA beat. The only hits are "candaceowens. com" at 01:20:38 and 01:21:32, both merch plugs, not tip requests. The host's mention that "someone emailed me" about Victor Marx and Greg Laurie (00:40:20, C-9733) is a received tip but uses none of the scan phrases. She also says she reached out to the Aspen donors (C-9766). No M-12 or M-14 occurrences are added.

- **Artifacts verbally referenced but not clearly shown**: A-2619.1 (the "Congress discreetly moves to merge US military" headline; the host says "you guys saw the headlines") and A-2627.1 (the White House FOIA response, a verbal reference only). The Daily Mail article on the video, the Megyn Kelly interview, Erika Kirk's fundraising email with Charlie's letter, and Trump's posts about the host are mentioned but not shown, so they are not inscribed as artifacts.

- **Name matching**: "Dana Loesch" (41:37) is minted as N-657 Dana Loesch. The context is the Turning Point summit speaker who attacked the host over Russia, and the host's earlier asides to "Dana" (27:36, 29:21) are taken to be her; nodes.tsv has no row for her. "Dugan" (41:37) is Alexander Dugin. "Paul Havsgaard" is mapped to N-451 Paul Havsgaard through its alias. "Aubrey" (51:07) is mapped to N-550 Aubrey Laitsch with medium confidence. The transcript says "Aubrey, Aubrey's husband. Um the one who used to work uh for Andrew Kolvet at", so it is ambiguous whether Aubrey or her husband worked for Kolvet. "Andrew Kolvet"/"Andrew Kolvet" are mapped to N-14. "Justin Streiff" is mapped to N-15. "Megyn Kelly" is mapped to N-46. "Vladimir Putin" reuses the node title minted as N-647 in staging episode 105. "Vance Voetberg" spelling is unverified and kept as transcribed. "Secretary Rubio" is minted as N-648 Marco Rubio from the host's reading of Loomer's tags.

- **Topic reuse**: N-10844 reuses the exact title "White House Military Office Erika Kirk Amplification Email" from staging episode 105. M-95 reuses the title "Emotional Response Asset" from staging episode 105, although here the host says only "emotional asset."

- **Transcription ambiguities**: "Dangerously Asens" and "Zarist Russia" in the Hertz article title are kept as transcribed. "Candace Tovia Moscowins" is a joke name. "WLS" in the email is the Women's Leadership Summit. "Conrad" in the TPUSA reply is likely "comrade." "Maxwell class" (01:11:42) probably means "Maxwell clan."
